name: Boon of the Bright Sun

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: Reference-only: Bonus Action creates sunlight in a 30-foot Bright Light Emanation, dispelling overlapping magical Darkness. Ends on free dismissal, death, or Incapacitated. On your turn starts, you and visible allies in it gain 10 Temporary HP.
